name: mob-spawner-cap
comment: WP-2.3 TileEntityMobSpawner's six-mob cap (TileEntityMobSpawner.java:52-56): tick/mob-spawner-spawn with six pigs spawned on the stone pad inside the spawner's box (the block at (3, 61, 3) expanded by 8, 4, 8). At t=20 the first try constructs a Pig through EntityList (an entity id and EntityLiving's Math.random draws; it never joins), getEntitiesWithinAABB(EntityPig) finds 6 >= 6: updateDelay (200 + nextInt(600)) and return, with no placement draw. rng_state and entity_state of all every tick.
